npcs.character: Calm, slow, kind; explains things with her hands.

The palace wall has a tower on each corner
wants: Everyone to move a little every day

explains.城墙: 很长很高的墙，以前在北京老城的外面。
explains.西北角: 西边和北边的中间那儿。
explains.狐狸: 像小狗，红色或者白色的。

npcs.name: 唱歌的爷爷

From here you can see the whole palace

explains.神笔: 画什么，什么就是真的的笔。

knows: The youngest takes the smallest pear

npcs.name: 小光
npcs.role: a quick-thinking boy playing by a big water jar

npcs.name: 甜甜
npcs.role: a cheerful livestreamer with a phone on a stick
npcs.character: Bright, fast, kind; greets her viewers with 「家人们！」 and says 「打卡！」 at every landmark. Gets history cheerfully wrong.

explains.直播: 用手机让很多人一起看你。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 那是北海的白塔！
nodes.translate: That's the White Dagoba of 北海!
nodes.why: 北海 was an imperial garden; its White Dagoba 白塔 has stood on the island since 1651.

nodes.say: 你看，这是我画的白塔。好看吗？
nodes.translate: Look, this is my painting of the White Dagoba. Is it good?

nodes.say: 谢谢！
nodes.translate: Thank you!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 坐一会儿吗？
nodes.translate: Sit for a while?

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 好，坐到晚上。
nodes.translate: Right — I'll sit till evening.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 现在不坐。
nodes.translate: Not now.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 你看！故宫很大很大！
nodes.translate: Look! The palace is huge!
nodes.why: From 景山 you see the whole Forbidden City, roof after golden roof, on Beijing's north–south axis.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 我们在上面找一找吧。
nodes.translate: Let's search from up here.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 故宫！
nodes.translate: The palace!

nodes.say: 你好！你累了吧？
nodes.translate: Hello! Tired, I bet?

nodes.say: 你看，这是故宫！很大吧？
nodes.translate: Look — the palace! Big, isn't it?

nodes.say: 我昨天晚上看见一只狐狸，在故宫西北角附近。
nodes.simpler: 我看见一只狐狸，在西北角。
nodes.translate: Last night I saw a fox, near the north-west corner of the palace.
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 西北 is north-west, 角 a corner, 附近 nearby. Ask the woman doing 太极 on the path — she explains them. The corner of the palace wall is by the corner tower, 角楼.

nodes.say: 晚上，你去看看狐狸吧！
nodes.translate: Go and look for the fox tonight!

nodes.say: 你好！这儿很好看吧？
nodes.translate: Hello! Beautiful up here, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 你是谁？你也怕我吧？老虎都怕我！
nodes.translate: Who are you? You're scared of me too, aren't you? Even tigers are scared of me!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 它这是狐假虎威。
nodes.translate: That's 狐假虎威 — the fox borrowing the tiger's might.
nodes.why: A 成语 📌 with a story: the fox walked in front of the tiger, the animals fled from the tiger, and the fox said they feared *him*. Look it up in your 成语 book.

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 好吧……你知道我叫什么吗？
nodes.translate: Fine… do you know my name?
nodes.why: Say its name: 九尾狐 — 九 nine, 尾 tail, 狐 fox. Tones: jiǔ wěi hú.

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 对！我是九尾狐。我们是朋友了！
nodes.translate: Yes! I'm the nine-tailed fox. We're friends now!

words.explain: 很大的猫，很大很大，大家都怕它。

nodes.say: 这个画给你。你给王阿姨吧。
nodes.translate: This painting is for you — give it to 王阿姨.

nodes.say: 我们打太极吧。你看，左手！
nodes.translate: Let's do some 太极. Watch — left hand!

nodes.say: 对！现在，右手！
nodes.translate: Yes! Now — right hand!

nodes.say: 很好！你会太极了！
nodes.translate: Very good! You can do 太极 now!

words.explain: 很慢很慢的运动，老人喜欢。

nodes.say: 我叫马良。我有神笔：我画什么，什么就活了！
nodes.translate: I’m 马良. I have a magic brush: whatever I paint comes alive!
nodes.why: Homage to the folk tale 《神笔马良》 (Ma Liang and the Magic Brush): a poor boy’s brush makes his paintings real, and he paints only for people who need it.

nodes.say: 你说，神笔画什么？
nodes.translate: Tell me — what shall I paint?

nodes.say: 好！……你看，它活了！
nodes.translate: Done! …Look, it’s alive!

nodes.say: 画龙的时候，眼睛要后画。有了眼睛，龙就活了。
nodes.translate: When you paint a dragon, the eyes come last. Paint the eyes, and the dragon lives.
nodes.why: That is 画龙点睛 — the finale of the story in the palace.

words.explain: 画什么，什么就是真的的笔。
用笔做一个东西的样子。

nodes.say: 妈妈给我们梨。我是弟弟，我拿哪个梨？
nodes.translate: Mum gave us pears. I’m the little brother — which pear do I take?
nodes.why: 孔融让梨: little 孔融, four years old, took the smallest pear — “I am small, so I take the small one.” Every Chinese child hears this story.

nodes.say: 对！我小，我拿小的梨。大的给哥哥。
nodes.translate: Right! I’m small, so I take the small pear. The big one is for my brother.

nodes.say: 不好了！我的朋友在水缸里！水很多！快！

options.label: 🪨 break the jar with a stone

nodes.translate: Help! My friend fell into the water jar! It’s full! Quick!
nodes.why: 司马光砸缸: when a friend fell into a great water jar, little 司马光 broke it with a stone instead of trying to pull him out.

nodes.say: 对！打破水缸，水出来了！他没事了！
nodes.translate: Yes! Break the jar and the water runs out! He’s fine!

words.explain: 打了，它就不好了，有很多小的。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 一只喜鹊！它飞了……去天上的桥那儿了。
nodes.translate: A magpie! Off it flies… to the bridge in the sky.

words.explain: 黑白色的鸟，中国人说它是好鸟。
在水上，人从上面走过去。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 一只喜鹊！它飞了……去天上的桥那儿了。
nodes.translate: A magpie! Off it flies… to the bridge in the sky.

words.explain: 黑白色的鸟，中国人说它是好鸟。
在水上，人从上面走过去。

nodes.say: 你好！景山上有五个亭子。你看看，最高的亭子叫什么？
nodes.translate: Hello! There are five pavilions on 景山. Have a look — what is the highest one called?
nodes.why: Read the signs along the ridge: 富览亭, 辑芳亭, 万春亭 (in the middle, on top), 观妙亭, 周赏亭. The middle one, on the city's axis, is the highest.

nodes.say: 对！万春亭最高。在那儿，你能看见故宫。
nodes.translate: Right! 万春亭 is the highest. From there you can see the palace.

words.explain: 有顶没有墙的小房子，在山上、在水边。

nodes.say: 你要去找那个狐狸吗？
nodes.translate: Are you going to find that fox?

nodes.say: 那个狐狸说，老虎也怕它。你看看这本书吧。
nodes.translate: That fox says even tigers are afraid of it. Have a look at this book.
nodes.why: He gives you 《狐假虎威》. Page 4: who walks in front, and who behind?

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 你是谁？你也怕我吧？老虎都怕我！
nodes.translate: Who are you? You're scared of me too, aren't you? Even tigers are scared of me!

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 你不怕？好，我在前面，老虎在哪儿？
nodes.translate: Not scared? Fine — when I'm in front, where is the tiger?
nodes.why: It's in 《狐假虎威》, page 4: 狐狸走在前面，老虎走在后面 — the animals ran from the tiger, not the fox.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 你看，我也有一个老虎！
nodes.translate: Look — I've got a tiger too!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 你听！
nodes.translate: Listen! (The toy tiger roars.)

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 啊！……好吧，好吧。大家怕的不是我，是后面的老虎。
nodes.translate: Aah! … All right, all right. It isn't me they're afraid of — it's the tiger behind.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 它这是狐假虎威。
nodes.translate: That's 狐假虎威 — the fox borrowing the tiger's might.
nodes.why: A 成语 📌 with a story — the one in the book. Look it up in your 成语 book.

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 你知道我叫什么吗？
nodes.translate: Do you know my name?
nodes.why: 九 nine, 尾 tail, 狐 fox: jiǔ wěi hú.

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 对！我是九尾狐。我们是朋友了！
nodes.translate: Yes! I'm the nine-tailed fox. We're friends now!

nodes.say: 家人们！我在景山直播，打卡！你们看，故宫！
nodes.translate: Fam! I'm streaming from 景山 — check-in! Look, the palace!

nodes.say: 故宫是秦始皇做的，很多很多年了！对吧？
nodes.translate: The palace was built by 秦始皇 — ages and ages ago! Right?
nodes.why: A key line 📌. The palace was built in the Ming (1406–1420) — 秦始皇 lived more than 1,600 years earlier. Say it kindly: 「不对，是明朝。」

nodes.say: 啊？明朝？家人们，他说是明朝！你们说呢？
nodes.translate: Huh? The Ming? Fam, they say it's the Ming! What do you think?

nodes.say: 谢谢你！我的直播，家人们都来打卡了。他们说：666！
nodes.translate: Thank you! Everyone's checking in on my stream. They say: 666 — awesome!
nodes.why: 666 (liù liù liù, like 溜) is internet Chinese for “awesome”.

words.explain: 用手机让很多人一起看你。
很多年前中国的一个朝代。
去一个有名的地方，拍照说“我来了”。

legend.zh: 《山海经》说，青丘山上有一只狐狸，它有九个尾巴。它的声音像小孩子。人们说，看见它，是好事。
legend.en: The Classic of Mountains and Seas says that on Mount Qingqiu lives a fox with nine tails, whose voice is like a child's. Seeing it, people said, was a good omen.

befriend.en: Say its name: 九尾狐, the nine-tailed fox.

idioms.meaning: to bully others with someone else's power — the fox borrowing the tiger's might

story.zh: 老虎要吃狐狸。狐狸说：“别吃我！动物们都怕我。你跟我走，你看看。”狐狸在前面走，老虎在后面走。动物们看见老虎，都跑了。老虎想：“它们真的怕狐狸！”
story.en: A tiger was about to eat a fox. The fox said: 'Don't! All the animals fear me. Walk behind me and see.' The fox walked in front, the tiger behind. The animals saw the tiger and fled — and the tiger thought: 'They really are afraid of the fox!'

items.name: 画
items.en: a painting of the White Dagoba

title.en: From 景山: the palace below

steps.en: The whole palace — 故宫 — laid out below us, roof after roof, all the way south.

title.en: A memory · Ice on 后海

steps.zh: 天冷的时候，我和爷爷去后海，在冰上玩。
steps.en: When it was cold, Grandpa and I went to 后海 and played on the ice.

steps.zh: 这个小狐狸，是看书画的。在冰上，我也是一个小狐狸！
steps.en: This little fox was painted from a book. On the ice, I was a little fox too!
A fox from a book, painted by a lantern maker. Two figures home now.

words.explain: 很冷的时候，水变得很硬。

title.en: End of chapter two · Water and the hill

steps.en: Two figures home: the lion and the fox. The fox even taught you a 成语.
Next: the shops of 王府井, and a stage at 前门 where the door gods are missing.
Her viewers are on your side — 666 means “awesome”. Built in the Ming, 1406 to 1420. 秦始皇 would be very surprised.

cards.en: The White Dagoba of 北海

facts.zh: 白塔是一六五一年建的。
facts.en: The White Dagoba was built in 1651.
facts.how: Read the sign by the White Dagoba.

facts.en: It stands on an island in the middle of the lake.
facts.how: Read the sign at the boat pier.

facts.zh: 北海很老，八百多年以前就有了。
facts.en: 北海 is China's oldest imperial garden, begun more than 800 years ago.
facts.how: Read the park's sign on the north shore.

cards.en: Jingshan, the hill behind the palace

facts.zh: 景山上有五个亭子，中间的万春亭最高。
facts.en: Five pavilions line the ridge; 万春亭 in the middle is the highest.
facts.how: Read the sign at 万春亭.

facts.zh: 故宫是明朝建的，不是秦始皇。
facts.en: The palace was built under the Ming, not by 秦始皇.
facts.how: Help 甜甜 get her history right.

cards.en: The corner tower and the fox

facts.zh: 狐狸走在前面，老虎走在后面，动物们怕的是老虎。
facts.en: The fox walks in front, the tiger behind — and the animals run from the tiger.

facts.zh: 这个故事，中国小学生都学。
facts.en: Every Chinese primary school pupil learns this story.
